title:
Riddle me, riddle me, randy ro.
 My father gave me seeds to sow.
html_source:
The full riddle:

Riddle me, riddle me, randy ro.
My father gave me seeds to sow.
The seed was black and the ground was white.
Riddle me that and I’ll give you a pipe.

The answer is “writing a letter”.
